get.description:
Returns the command schema for a given control stream. With the
commandFormat query parameter, returns the schema registered
for that command format.

put.description:
Registers the schema for its command format (replacing any
existing schema with the same commandFormat, adding a new
format otherwise) and makes it the control stream's current
schema. The formats list reflects all registered schemas.
